name: Moon Touch New Zafrani Facial Kit | Saffron Brightening Herbal Facial Set for Glowing Skin (8 Pcs)
description:
Experience salon-style skincare at home with the Moon Touch New Zafrani Facial Kit, a complete 8-piece herbal facial system formulated to enhance brightness and restore a healthy, radiant glow. Enriched with pure saffron (Zafaran) and natural herbal extracts, this advanced facial kit helps reduce the appearance of pigmentation, dark spots, and dullness while improving overall skin texture. Designed for face and neck care, this step-by-step facial routine deeply nourishes, hydrates, and revitalizes the skin. With regular use, your skin looks smoother, clearer, and visibly more luminous.

 Enriched with pure saffron for a natural glow
 Helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and pigmentation

 Supports skin rejuvenation and youthful appearance
 Deeply nourishes and hydrates
 Improves overall skin texture and smoothness
 Suitable for all skin types
 Ideal for both face and neck care
Product Details
 Product Type: Herbal Facial Kit
 Total Pieces: 8-Step Facial System
 Key Ingredient: Saffron (Zafaran)
 Skin Type: All Skin Types
 Usage: At-home facial treatment
Benefits
 Promotes a radiant and healthy-looking complexion
 Helps improve dull and uneven skin tone
 Leaves skin soft, smooth, and refreshed
 Supports clearer and brighter-looking skin
How to Use
 Cleanse face with a gentle face wash and pat dry
 Apply Zafrani Facial products step by step as directed
 Massage gently in circular motions
 Leave on for 10–15 minutes as required

Ingredients
 Saffron (Zafaran)
 Herbal Extracts
